title: YouTube Long Form Editor + Shorts Creator
description:
YouTube Long Form Editor + Shorts Creator 



About Us & The Opportunity

We are InvestorsFunnel. We run a real estate investment business to help people buy houses and make money in real estate. Now we area hiring a talented video editor to help us build a client acquisition content machine using YouTube long-form videos and short-form social media content to generate views, attention, leads, and partnerships.

At InvestorsFunnel, we believe our people are our greatest asset. We invest heavily in growth, development, and rewarding performance.



The Editing Role 

We are hiring immediately - This is a full time job. 40 hours per week expected. As a full time editor, You will be responsible for turning raw calls and talking head videos into engaging and attention retaining videos. You'll be editing real sales calls, real negotiations, real business content that teaches marketing, sales, persuasion, and entrepreneurship.

This is a high-output production role focused on quality, consistency and execution. 



Responsibilities and Success Metrics

Consistent communication

Minimum 3 long-form videos weekly

Minimum 12 shorts weekly (4-10+ clips per long-form video

Turnaround Time: Ideally 24 hours per video

(Edits are kept clean and very simple so speed is achievable)

Accurate posting and scheduling content across: YouTube, Instagram Reels, and TikTok /
 (as needed) 

Accuracy: Correctly blur/remove all sensitive information (names, addresses, phone numbers, etc.)

Consistency: No missed deadlines, steady weekly output

Your role is not just editing, it’s helping distribute content at scale on YouTube and social media channels.



Compensation

Expected Earnings Range:  $480 - $1,000+/month

Guaranteed Base Compensation and Performance Bonuses: Additional compensation for every video and short produced beyond minimum requirements.

Higher compensation, leadership responsibilities, and promotion opportunities based on performance.

This role rewards people who can edit fast and produce volume.



The Qualifications - Who This Is For

You can edit long-form videos (30 to 60+ minutes)

You are fast, consistent, and reliable

You communicate fast  

You can follow instructions and pay attention to detail

You’re comfortable with high-volume, repetitive work

You want stable work with growth potential

You are open to learning skills beyond editing (content, business, sales exposure)

We are NOT looking for MrBeast-style edits.

We prefer:

Clean cuts

Zoom-ins

Captions

Graphics and B-Roll when needed

Retention-focused editing

Fast turnaround over excessive effects.



Tools Required:

Premiere Pro

CapCut

Final Cut

or DaVinci





Benefits & Growth Opportunity (What You Gain Here)

This is where this role is different.

You get paid bonuses on each edited video posted beyond the minimum requirement 

You are not just editing videos, you are exposed to high-level business content daily.

Most of the footage includes:

Real estate sales calls with homeowners in many different states in the USA

Negotiation conversations

Educational “talking head” business content

By working in this role, you will naturally learn:

Sales and closing frameworks

Negotiation skills

How real deals are structured

How content drives revenue

Growth Path For More Responsibility and More Money:

Editor ? Content Operator —> Team Lead (manage other editors) —> Head of Media

As our content operation grows, we plan to hire additional editors. Top performers may be promoted into management roles overseeing other editors and content systems. 

Top performers move into higher-responsibility roles within 6–12 months, with increased income tied to performance and ownership.

The goal: as you improve, your income increases.



How to Apply (READ CAREFULLY)

To be considered:

Send 2–4 examples of videos you’ve edited (long-form preferred)

Send 2–3 short-form clips you’ve created

Include the word “DETAILS” at the top of your application

Answer these questions briefly:

Are you fast with communication?

How fast can you deliver a 30–60 min long-form video?

How many clips can you make from one long-form video?

IF YOU DON’T FOLLOW INSTRUCTIONS, YOUR APPLICATION WILL NOT BE REVIEWED.



Final Note (Read This)

We are only hiring 1–3 people.

This is a high-output role with real upside, but it’s not for everyone. The workload is consistent, expectations are clear, and performance matters.

If you want a real opportunity to grow your income and be part of building something — apply now.

- Familiarity with Go High Level CRM tools helpful but not required — we will train the right person



What You'll Get

- Hourly base pay (flexible based on experience and fit)

- Performance bonus per closed client — this is where the real earning potential is

- Full training on our product, our industry, and our proven sales process

- Access to a knowledge base and AI tools built specifically for this role

- All calls routed and recorded through our system — you'll always have support

- A small, focused team that treats people well and rewards results



Important

You must be available during US Central or Eastern business hours — mornings and early afternoons preferred. 



To Apply

Send us a voice introduction — 60 to 90 seconds — telling us who you are, why you're a fit, and what sales experience you've had.

title: VSL Video Editor
description:
OVERVIEW

We are looking for a skilled VSL (Video Sales Letter) Editor who can craft long-form, high-converting video content for e-commerce and DTC brands. This is not a short-form or social media role — you will own the full VSL production pipeline, turning raw scripts, footage, and voiceovers into polished sales videos that drive measurable revenue outcomes.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

•	VSL Production: Edit full-length VSLs (typically 5–30 minutes) from provided scripts, voiceovers, and b-roll footage — structured to maximise viewer retention and purchase intent.

•	DR Structure & Flow: Apply proven Direct Response frameworks: strong hook and problem identification in the opening segment, benefit-stacking through the body, and a high-urgency close with clear CTA.

•	Visual Storytelling: Build compelling visual narratives that support the sales script — using text overlays, callouts, product close-ups, testimonial segments, and supporting graphics to reinforce key selling points.

•	Audio & Pacing: Master voiceover pacing, background music layering, and sound design to maintain engagement throughout long-form content. Silence and timing are as important as visuals.

•	Iteration Based on Data: Produce A/B testing variants (different hooks, CTAs, segment reordering) based on performance feedback — view-through rate, drop-off points, and conversion data.

•	Platform Optimisation: Export and format VSLs for web-hosted sales pages, YouTube pre-roll, and
 funnels. Understand the difference between a hosted VSL and a paid ad placement.

•	Asset Management: Maintain organised project files, source footage, and export versions for handoff to media buyers and funnel builders.



MUST-HAVES

•	Proven VSL editing portfolio — at least 2–3 examples of long-form sales videos (not short-form ads or brand content) with demonstrated conversion outcomes.

•	Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro, with clean, well-structured timelines.

•	Deep understanding of Direct Response marketing: you know what a hook, a benefit stack, a proof section, and a close look like — and how to pace them visually.

•	Experience working with voiceover-led content and synchronising visuals to narration beats.

•	Comfort with text-heavy editing — callouts, chapter titles, emphasis overlays, and on-screen proof elements (screenshots, testimonials, stats).

•	Performance mindset — you treat data (watch time, drop-off, CVR) as creative direction, not criticism.

•	Reliable fast turnaround: first cuts within 48 hours; revisions within 24 hours.



BONUS SKILLS

•	Experience with animated explainer-style segments or whiteboard/kinetic typography within VSLs.

•	Proficiency in After Effects for lower thirds, animated callouts, and motion graphics.

•	Familiarity with VSL hosting platforms (Wistia, Vimeo, ClickFunnels embedded video).

•	Understanding of funnel architecture — how a VSL fits into a sales page, order bump, and upsell flow.

•	Experience editing for supplement, info-product, or high-ticket e-commerce VSL formats.



ENGAGEMENT DETAILS:

Schedule	Flexible / output-based — strict deadlines apply

Onboarding	Paid trial project before transitioning to ongoing engagement



To Apply:

If you are an exceptional designer with a portfolio that demonstrates world-class DTC brand quality, kindly fill out the application form:






Looking forward to receiving your application!

title: Technology Delivery Lead
description:
WeFlex helps people with a disability, people in aged care, and Australian war veterans live longer, healthier lives through access to physical fitness, allied health and therapy supports. We're a registered NDIS provider. We've delivered over 50,000 sessions, grown 30x in 2.5 years, and we plan to keep doubling every year.



The seat

Our COO sets the business priorities. Your job is to make them ship.



You sit between the business and the build. A priority comes in ("clients aren't reporting back", "kill our legacy CRM"). You work out the real problem, scope it, sequence it, build part of it yourself, and run the delivery cadence so the team ships the rest, tested and documented.



How the tech function is structured:



The COO owns vision and business priorities. She d
 what matters and approves what gets built.

You, the Technology Delivery Lead, own the delivery engine: intake, scoping, sequencing, sprint cadence, BAU stability, documentation, and the development of our two junior devs. You also build.

Our Technology Solutions & Data Lead is your senior peer. He owns deep architecture, data and AI capability, and takes the hardest technical problems.

Two junior developers report to you.

Day-to-day you work directly with the COO. She sets priorities, you align the delivery plan with her, and development runs through scoping and review gates to catch mistakes early.



What you'll do day-to-day

Turn business problems into specs. You take an ambiguous brief from an exec and produce a scoped doc: the actual problem, what's in and out of scope, requirements with acceptance criteria, and how we'll test it.

Run delivery. Sprint cadence, ClickUp board, intake triage, dependencies, blockers raised early, weekly delivery reporting. You always know the status of everything in flight.

Build. You personally ship mid-complexity automations and systems: n8n workflows, Airtable systems, integrations across Supabase, GoHighLevel, Zendesk, Xero and our internal portals.

Keep the lights on. Bugs triaged, broken automations fixed or routed, systems stable, documentation current.

Coach. You review the juniors' work, pair with them on problems, and keep the quality bar high.

On AI

This part is a hard requirement. Claude, GPT, Cursor or equivalents need to already be core to how you diagnose, scope, build and document. The most effective tech lead we've had wasn't our strongest raw developer. He was the best we've seen at using AI to close that gap, and he out-shipped people with twice his experience. We hire for that pattern. The build task is where you show us yours.



Who fits

Your career path looks something like business analyst, then product owner, then delivery or tech lead, ideally on a live software product. Ten years of solo senior-engineer titles is the wrong path for this seat.

You've run delivery inside someone else's structure (a PM system, a product org, an exec's priorities) and got good at it.

You've shipped real automations and systems yourself and can show them: workflows, integrations, internal tools.

You've developed juniors who got measurably better under you, and you can name them when we ask for references.

You write plain business English. A COO can read your specs and Looms without a translator.

We weight what you can actually do over degrees, years of experience or industry background.



What this role isn't

A strategy seat. The COO owns business priorities and the roadmap; this role turns them into delivered systems.

A heavy DevOps, Kubernetes or infrastructure role. We run managed low-code at scale.

Open to agencies or dev shops. Individual, exclusive, full-time applicants only. No concurrent client work.

Pay and logistics

PHP 90,000 to 220,000 per month, depending on demonstrated capability.

Full-time, fully remote, AEST-aligned hours, Philippines-based.

To apply

Submit here: 



Two parts:



Part 1: application form. CV, portfolio link, 7 short written answers, notice period and salary expectation.



Part 2: build task. A real WeFlex scenario with sample data. You build a working artifact and record a short Loom walking through your thinking, your tool choice and your AI workflow. There's no time limit. We score the quality of the build.



We don't review applications without a completed build task. It's the highest-weight signal in our process.



Reviewed weekly. Open until filled.

I'm a clinical psychologist and author running a YouTube channel in the anxiety and mental health space. I create weekly talking head videos (5-20 minutes) and need an editor who can take clean footage and make it look polished and professional.



What the work involves:



I film talking head footage and edit out mistakes before sending it to you.

 

Your job is to take that clean footage and produce a finished video that includes:

~B-roll sourced and placed to support the teaching

~Text overlays and on-screen graphics that reinforce key points

~Subtitles/captions (accurate, clean, correctly formatted)

~Overall colour grading and audio polish

~A professional, clear look that matches a health/education brand (not flashy, not trendy)



Bonus if you can also repurpose each video into Shorts or TikTok cuts. This isn't required, but if you can do it well, there is ongoing work there.



Volume and pay



One video per week. Maximum 5 hours per video including any repurposes. Rate is $10 USD per hour.

Shortlisted candidates will be given a trial edit — one video up to 10 minutes — paid at the same rate. If the trial is successful, this becomes a long-term ongoing role.



What I'm looking for



~Experience editing long-form talking head content (health, education, or coaching niche preferred)

~Good eye for b-roll selection that matches the teaching, not just generic stock

~Able to work independently with minimal direction once you understand the brand

~Reliable, communicative, and meets deadlines without chasing

~Comfortable with a structured brand style (colours, fonts, visual standards)



What I'm NOT looking for



~Heavy motion graphics or flashy editing

~Someone who needs daily management

~Beginners building a portfolio



To apply



~Send me a link to 2-3 examples of long-form talking head videos you've edited. 

~Tell me in 3-4 sentences why this kind of content suits you specifically. 

~Use the subject line YOUTUBER2026 when you apply, and at the start of your message tell me which editing software you use and what your typical turnaround time is for a 15-minute video.



I will not respond to applications that do not follow these instructions.

title: Remote HubSpot & Asana Administrator — Brown Haven Homes
description:
Location: Remote 



Work Hours: 8:30 am – 5:30 pm EST (New York time zone), Monday – Friday



Brown Haven Homes is a growing homebuilder, and we're hiring a remote HubSpot & Asana Administrator whose entire focus is keeping our two most important systems healthy, well-organized, and working properly. HubSpot runs our marketing and sales; Asana runs how the whole company gets work done across architecture, construction, sales, and operations. You'll be the go-to expert who, maintains, supports, and continuously improves both platforms — and the person teammates turn to when something isn't working. This role has significant growth potential, with the opportunity for performance-based monthly bonuses, career advancement, and a collaborative, supportive team environment where you'll learn, grow, and have fun!



What You'll Do



HubSpot administration



Own the day-to-day health and administration of our HubSpot portal across Marketing Hub and Sales Hub

Manage users, teams, permissions, and seats; keep access clean as people join, change roles, and leave

Build and maintain properties, deal pipelines and stages, record layouts, and association labels

Support the sales team in HubSpot — deal stages,
s, automations, sequences, and dashboards

Create, maintain, and monitor workflows and automations — and proactively catch and fix the ones that break or misfire

Build and maintain lists/segments, forms,
 templates, landing pages, and marketing campaigns

Keep data clean: deduplicate records, manage imports/exports, enforce required fields and validation, and run regular data-hygiene passes

Build and maintain dashboards and reports for sales, marketing, and leadership

Monitor
 deliverability and overall portal health, and keep templates, snippets, and documentation current





Asana administration



Own the health and administration of the Brown Haven Homes Asana workspace — teams, members, guests, and permissions

Provision and deprovision users, and reassign tasks and projects cleanly when tea
mbers change roles or depart

Build and maintain project templates, custom fields, intake forms, rules/automations, portfolios, and dashboards

Build simple, scalable systems — our current Asana workspace has grown sprawling and overly complex (neither simple nor scalable), and a core part of this role is streamlining and rebuilding it to be clean, consistent, and built to scale

Standardize project structure and naming across offices and teams, and keep the workspace tidy by archiving stale projects and fixing broken rules

Drive adoption — train teams, answer "how do I…" questions, and build clear SOPs and how-to guides

Maintain portfolios and reporting that give leadership visibility into work across the company

Across both platforms

Serve as the first point of contact for HubSpot and Asana questions, requests, and issues — triage, resolve, and follow up until it's truly fixed

Meet our resolution targets: roughly 90% of incoming issues resolved within 24 hours, with the remaining ~10% (larger build-outs) delivered within 2 weeks at most

Own and monitor the HubSpot ? Asana integration and other connected apps, troubleshooting sync issues and escalating when needed

Document configuration, processes, and standards so the systems stay maintainable

Partner with marketing, sales, and operations to translate their needs into clean, reliable system configuration

Keep both platforms running properly day to day, spotting and resolving problems before they spread

Maintain the confidentiality and security of sensitive company and customer information





Experience Requirements



Proven hands-on HubSpot administration experience across Marketing Hub and Sales Hub — building properties, deal pipelines, workflows, lists, forms,
/campaigns, and reports

Proven hands-on Asana administration experience managing teams, templates, custom fields, rules/automations, forms, and portfolios

Strong understanding of CRM data hygiene, segmentation, and workflow/automation logic

Experience building dashboards and reports that non-technical stakeholders can actually use

Comfort troubleshooting integrations and platform sync issues, with the instinct to isolate root cause and document the fix

Process- and documentation-oriented, with the ability to train and support non-technical users patiently and clearly

Strong organizational and time management skills, able to juggle requests and prioritize against business impact

Excellent written and verbal communication, available during US business hours

Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented, with a "make it happen" attitude — you take ownership and drive issues to resolution instead of waiting to be told what to do





Bonus Skills



HubSpot certifications (e.g., Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, Operations Hub, or Reporting)

Asana certifications or formal Workflow Specialist experience

Experience with HubSpot Operations Hub, data sync, programmable/custom-coded workflows, or the HubSpot API

Experience connecting tools with Zapier, Make, or n8n

Reporting/analytics skills (Google Sheets, Looker Studio, or SQL)

Experience in homebuilding, construction, or real estate





Technical Requirements



A primary computer with sufficient RAM and processing power to run multiple admin, reporting, and communication tools simultaneously (including 10+ tabs in Google Chrome)

Primary internet service with speeds of at least 50 Mbps

Backup power supply (reimbursement available if you need to purchase)





Application Process



Please complete the following steps to apply.
 bogdan at 
 with the subject line:

Application - Remote HubSpot & Asana Admin - [Your First and Last Name]



In the body of the
, include:



A Google Drive link to a brief video introduction of yourself, discussing your work history, your experience administering HubSpot and Asana, and what you like to do for fun

A Google Drive link to your resume/CV (and any relevant certifications or portfolio, if available)

Two professional references along with contact information for both

A link to past deliverables and work you’ve produced in Hubspot and Asana 



Important Requirement — I'd also like you to include in the
:



An outline of your 3 top strengths and how you've come to realize they're your top strengths over your career

The 1–3 top job functions you've most disliked in other roles you've had

3 things you're actively learning or working on improving right now

The last time you failed at a task and what happened afterward



Once you complete the above, I'll reach out with a meeting link to schedule a time for us to chat.



Thank you!

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Full Stack Developer (Angular / AWS) — Remote, Full-Time



THE ROLE



We need a developer who owns things. Not "I did my ticket" — we mean taking a feature from a rough idea or a Figma file all the way to production: building the UI, wiring the backend, deploying the infrastructure, and standing behind the result.



You'll be joining a small remote team where your work ships fast and actually matters. If you sweat the details — spacing, performance, edge cases, the stuff that makes software feel solid — you'll fit right in.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Build and maintain responsive web apps in Angular + TypeScript

- Turn designs into pixel-clean, accessible UI with strong layout, typography, and motion

- Write backend logic on AWS Lambda (Python and/or Node.js)

- Define and deploy infrastructure with AWS SAM

- Configure CloudFront for fast, secure delivery of assets and APIs

- Work directly with product and design to shape the UX

- Write and maintain tests on both ends of the stack

- Review code honestly and keep the bar high

- Debug real production issues — performance, reliability, usability

- Help us improve architecture and tooling as we grow



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- 5+ years of professional web application development

- Strong Angular (v10+) with TypeScript/JavaScript

- Hands-on serverless experience with AWS Lambda

- Python on the backend

- AWS SAM for infrastructure and deployments

- CloudFront experience (CDN, caching, secure delivery)

- Serious UI skills: advanced CSS (Flexbox, Grid, animations, responsive layouts), solid UI/UX fundamentals, a real eye for layout, spacing, typography, and visual hierarchy

- Strong web fundamentals: HTML5, REST APIs, HTTP, browser behavior, performance

- Unit/component testing (Jest, Jasmine, Karma, or similar)

- Comfortable with Git and standard branching workflows

- Able to work independently, communicate clearly, and collaborate without hand-holding



BONUS POINTS (NOT REQUIRED)



- Other AWS services: API Gateway, S3, Cognito, DynamoDB, CloudWatch

- Angular component libraries or design systems (Material, PrimeNG, custom)

- CI/CD pipelines (automated testing and deployment)

- Performance profiling and optimization, frontend or backend



HOW WE WORK



Remote and async-friendly. Small team, real ownership, no micromanagement — but high standards. You'll have a genuine say in how things get built.



One ask: if you apply, be ready to actually talk. We move quickly and we value clear, direct communication. Tell us specifically about your Angular and AWS work — generic applications get noticed for the wrong reasons.

title: Full-Time Virtual Assistant / Operations Manager — Canva, Squarespace & Membership Site (Exclusive, Long-Term)
description:
About the Role



I run a growing membership and online course business in the medical/aesthetics education space. It's an established business with a long track record, loyal customers, and serious room to grow.



I'm looking for ONE full-time, exclusive Virtual Assistant to become the operational backbone of this business. This is not a side gig, not a part-time role, and not one client among many. This is a long-term, full-time career position for someone who wants stability, growth, and real responsibility.



Why this is a great opportunity:



You'll work directly with a founder with years of experience in this space — you'll learn skills and gain experience that compound for years.

This is a stable, long-term commitment. I want someone who grows with the business for years, not months.

You won't just execute tasks — you'll run things. Over time, you'll take ownership of operations so I can focus on growth. You're essentially a business partner who makes our digital products run.



What You'll Do



Manage our membership site month to month: updating monthly deliverables, uploading new assets, keeping content organized and on schedule.

Coordinate directly with our graphic designer — requesting assets, giving feedback, tracking deadlines, and making sure deliverables are ready on time every month.

Make edits and updates to our Squarespace website (pages, content, layout updates).

Create and edit designs in Canva following our brand guidelines.

Handle general business operations: organizing files, managing schedules and recurring tasks, keeping systems documented and running.

Communicate proactively: send regular updates on what's done, what's in progress, and what needs my attention — so nothing falls through the cracks.

Take ownership. When something breaks or is unclear, you figure it out or flag it early. The goal is that I can step away and trust that the business keeps running.



What I Provide



Full-time, stable monthly salary (paid reliably, on time)

Brand guidelines, templates, and documented processes

Direct training and mentorship fro
 as you learn the business

A long-term role with growing responsibility (and compensation that grows with it)

Paid onboarding period to learn our systems



What I Expect



Exclusivity: This is a FULL-TIME role. No other clients, no side jobs. I'm paying for your full focus and in return offering stability and long-term growth. Please do not apply if you plan to keep other clients.

Reliability: Available during agreed working hours, responsive to messages, consistent day-to-day.

Ownership: You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks. If something is at risk of being late or wrong, you raise it early.

Proactive communication: Regular status updates without being asked. I should always know how things are going.

Trustworthiness: You'll have access to business systems and accounts. Integrity and discretion are non-negotiable.

Attention to detail: Membership deliverables go out to paying customers — accuracy and polish matter.



Skills I'm Looking For



Proven experience with Canva (design and editing within brand guidelines)

Experience making edits in Squarespace (or a similar website builder, with willingness to master Squarespace fast)

Experience managing a membership site, course platform, or recurring content/deliverables schedule

Strong general operations skills: organized, systems-minded, good with checklists and deadlines

Excellent written and spoken English

Experience coordinating with other contractors (designers, editors, etc.) is a big plus

Bonus: familiarity with online courses, digital products, or the medical/aesthetics industry



Compensation



Full-time monthly salary

Long-term stability: I'm hiring for years, not a project



How to Apply



To apply, include the following in your message:



Type "pineapple" in the first line of your application so I know you read the full posting.

A 2-minute video introduction: who you are, where you're from, and why a long-term, exclusive full-time role appeals to you.

Examples of your work: Canva designs you've created and/or websites you've managed or edited (Squarespace especially).

A short description of a time you managed something end-to-end for a client or employer (a project, a site, a recurring process) — what it was and what you were responsible for.

Confirm that you are available full-time with no other clients, and your expected monthly salary.



Next Steps



If your application stands out, I'll invite you to a 30–45 minute video interview.

Finalists will complete a paid test project (a realistic sample of the actual work: a Canva task, a Squarespace edit, and a coordination/communication exercise).

From there, I'll choose one person to start with a paid trial month, leading to the permanent full-time role.



This is the right fit if you want one stable, full-time position where you're trusted with real responsibility, paid reliably, and given the chance to grow into the operational leader of an established digital business.

You take charge and make things happen. You don't make excuses. You have an internal drive to grow something and you'll do whatever it takes.

Message a short cover letter + resume as a response to this job post.

title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
OVERVIEW



Consult Lemonade is seeking a detail-oriented, proactive, and mission-aligned Executive Assistant to directly support the CEO.



This role exists to protect the CEO's capacity for strategic work, including fundraising, partnerships, program expansion, and organizational growth. The Executive Assistant handles the administrative and operational infrastructure that keeps leadership moving efficiently while also serving as a key contributor to grant development and management in partnership with the organization's grant lead.



This is not an entry-level administrative position. We are seeking an experienced Executive Assistant who can confidently support executive leadership, manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, and operate independently in a fast-paced environment. While every organization has its own processes and systems, candidates should already possess strong Executive Assistant fundamentals and experience supporting senior leaders.



SCHEDULE



* Part-time position

* Monday through Friday

* 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM EST

* Opportunity for additional hours and expanded responsibilities as the organization grows



LEADING PEOPLE



You do not manage a team, but you represent the CEO's office in every interaction.



Your professionalism, responsiveness, discretion, and follow-through reflect directly on Consult Lemonade's leadership. You will be trusted with sensitive information, key relationships, organizational priorities, and executive communications. This role requires maturity, professionalism, and a high level of integrity.



DELIVERING RESULTS



* CEO calendar is managed proactively with meetings scheduled, conflicts resolved, and preparation materials organized in advance.

* Follow-up items from CEO meetings are tracked, assigned, and completed without requiring the CEO to reinitiate action.

* CEO inbox is actively managed with communications sorted, prioritized, and monitored to ensure timely responses.

* Active partnerships, grants, and community relationships are maintained in a living tracking system with current status updates and next steps documented.

* Organizational priorities are coordinated across teams with the CEO informed and never surprised.

* Grant opportunities are researched and presented to leadership on a regular basis.

* Grant applications, proposals, Letters of Intent (LOIs), one-pagers, and supporting documentation are prepared, submitted, and maintained accurately and on time.

* Grant reporting requirements, compliance deadlines, and supporting records are maintained in an organized, audit-ready system.

* Leverages AI and automation tools appropriately to streamline administrative processes, improve efficiency, and reduce manual workload while maintaining accuracy and quality.

* Administrative burden on leadership is measurably reduced through strong ownership and execution.



COMMUNICATION



* Serve as the first point of contact for the CEO's office, including scheduling requests,
 communications, and external inquiries.

* Own the day-to-day management of the CEO's inbox, including prioritization, organization, drafting responses, and ensuring no communication falls through the cracks.

* Partner closely with the organization's grant lead to support grant writing coordination, deadlines, submissions, and documentation.

* Ensure internal teams receive clear communication regarding CEO priorities, decisions, and expectations.

* Handle sensitive communications with confidentiality and sound judgment.

* Document action items, commitments, and decisions from CEO meetings and ensure appropriate follow-up.



STRATEGIC THINKING



* Understand the CEO's priorities well enough to make informed decisions regarding scheduling, access, and time management.

* Anticipate needs before meetings, events, deadlines, and major initiatives.

* Monitor funding opportunities and trends relevant to Consult Lemonade's mission and programs.

* Identify administrative inefficiencies and recommend practical solutions that improve organizational effectiveness.



ACCOUNTABILITY



* Provide weekly executive briefings that include calendar updates, open action items, grant deadlines, and partnership status reports.

* Ensure no grant deadline or compliance requirement is missed without advance notice and a documented plan.

* Maintain accurate and current records within all tracking and CRM systems.

* Ensure executive communications and follow-up expectations are consistently met.

* Protect CEO capacity by owning responsibilities that should not require executive involvement.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Minimum of 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Executive Coordinator, Project Coordinator, Administrative Operations Professional, or similar role.

* Demonstrated experience directly supporting senior executives, founders, CEOs, or C-suite leadership.

* Strong executive calendar management and inbox management experience.

* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, projects, and stakeholders simultaneously.

* Experience working in a fast-paced, mission-driven, nonprofit, startup, or growth-oriented environment.

* Strong organizational and project management skills.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* Experience using project management, collaboration, and CRM systems.

* Comfortable working with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar platforms to support research, communication, organization, documentation, and administrative efficiency.

* High degree of discretion, trustworthiness, professionalism, and sound judgment.

* Strong alignment with Consult Lemonade's mission of supporting underrepresented talent in technology.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Experience with grant research, grant writing, or nonprofit grant management.

* Familiarity with federal, state, corporate, and foundation funding opportunities.

* Experience coordinating cross-functional projects and organizational initiatives.

* Experience supporting a founder, CEO, or executive leadership team.

* Familiarity with HubSpot, Notion, Asana, Jira, Google Workspace, or similar platforms.



IMMEDIATE HIRE OPPORTUNITY



This is an immediate-hire opportunity for a candidate who can step into the role with confidence and professionalism. We are seeking someone who already understands the fundamentals of executive support and can quickly contribute to the success of the CEO and organization.



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered for this position, applicants must submit all of the following:



1. A current resume that includes complete employment history with start and end dates for each position.



2. A professional portfolio showcasing relevant work, accomplishments, projects, or case studies that demonstrate Executive Assistant, operations, project coordination, executive support, or organizational management experience.



3. A detailed introduction video that includes:



   * Your Executive Assistant experience

   * The executives or leaders you have supported

   * Examples of complex responsibilities you have managed

   * Why you are interested in this opportunity

   * Why you believe you are a strong fit for Consult Lemonade



4. Must use at least 10 apply points to be considered.  



Applications that do not include all three required components will not be reviewed. Attention to detail is a critical part of this role, and complete application submissions are part of the evaluation process.

title: Expert Customer Experience Specialist
description:
Summary

• Schedule: Mon–Fri, 7:00 AM – 1:00 PM US PST (22:00–04:00 Manila)

• Hours: 30 per week

• Compensation: $7–$8/hr DOE + 13th-month bonus + $50/month Health & SSS allowance

• Experience: 3–5 years in customer service & e-commerce



Synergy Wetsuits designs and builds triathlon wetsuits, tri suits, and swim accessories trusted by beginners and elite athletes worldwide. As our Expert Customer Experience Specialist, you’ll lead day-to-day customer support, maintain high service standards, and help us deliver an exceptional experience at every touchpoint. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and results matter.



What You’ll Do

• Deliver outstanding customer support via
, phone, live chat, and social DMs — always within SLA.

• Manage orders, edits, cancellations, replacements, and RMAs in Shopify.

• Oversee returns, exchanges, repairs, and quality control processes.

• Monitor marketplace cases and reviews (Amazon, eBay, Walmart) and follow through on resolutions.

• Maintain accurate customer data and reporting across all platforms.

• Collaborate with operations, sales, and warehouse teams to resolve issues efficiently.

• Document and continuously improve CX SOPs, macros, and help center content.



Must-Haves

• Shopify expertise: managing orders, refunds/exchanges, discounts, tags, and basic inventory notes.

• 3–5 years in customer service or inside sales support, ideally in sporting goods, apparel, or a related industry.

• 3+ years managing Amazon Seller Central (FBA & FBM); eBay experience required.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook; quick to learn new systems.

• Excellent written and spoken English — professional, clear, and empathetic.

• Highly organized, self-driven, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

• Problem solver who remains calm under pressure and handles tough cases with maturity.

• A true customer advocate who knows how to balance business goals with customer satisfaction.

• Must pass a background check and drug screening.



Nice-to-Haves

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

• Experience with Gorgias, Zendesk, ShipStation, or similar CX tools.

• Logistics or shipping knowledge (carriers, claims, basic WMS).

• Background in endurance sports or a strong interest in triathlon and open-water swimming products.



First 90-Day Outcomes

• Consistently hit response and resolution SLAs.

• Create or improve 3+ macros/SOPs to streamline repetitive tasks.

• Reduce return and exchange processing time with measurable improvements.

• Pass end-of-month assessments and performance reviews to demonstrate progress and alignment with company standards.



About Synergy Wetsuits

Synergy started in the 1990s when triathlete and coach Stefan Laursen began refining wetsuit designs to help athletes swim faster, stay warmer, and feel calmer on race day. Today, we serve athletes across the U.S. and Europe from our Minden, NV HQ, offering premium wetsuits, tri suits, and swim gear.



We’re a small, hands-on team passionate about building products people trust at 5:30 a.m. start lines. We test in cold lakes, busy pools, and at race expos. We treat customers like teammates: clear answers, fair fixes, no runaround.



If you thrive on solving real customer problems, enjoy working in a collaborative environment, and want to be part of a team trusted by athletes worldwide, you’ll fit right in.



How to Apply

 
 with the subject line:

“CX Specialist – [Your Name]” and include:



1. Written answers:

• Why are you a great fit for this role?

• Your customer service and sales experience.

• Your e-commerce experience.

• Years and scope of Amazon Seller Central experience.

• Microsoft Office proficiency (rate 1–10).

• Can you work Mon–Fri, 7:00 AM – 1:00 PM US PST?

• Confirm that $7–$8/hr for 30 hrs/week is acceptable.



2. Resume:

• PDF preferred. Include LinkedIn or portfolio links if relevant.



3. Short intro video:

• 60–90 seconds introducing yourself, why you want this role, and why Synergy.

• Share a viewable link (Google Drive, Dropbox, or Loom) and confirm permissions.



Helpful Tips

• Keep your writing clear and concise.

• Use proper file names: Lastname_Firstname_Resume.pdf and Lastname_Firstname_Intro.(link or mp4).

• If you have sample macros or SOPs you’ve created, attach or link them.



Review Process

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Incomplete applications cannot be considered, so please ensure all three components are included.

• A passion for and participation in the sports we serve.

mbers will also provide guidance when needed.

 Page:

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

mber who understands the current workflow

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.

Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.

title: Electrical and PCB Design Engineer
description:
T-Bird Drones is a stealth startup company that is pursuing the development of drone technologies.



An engineer is needed to support the design of printed circuit boards (PCB) and electrical systems on a drone.  The ideal candidate brings expertise in PCB layout, power electronics, signal integrity, EMI mitigation, and RF-aware design.  It is necessary to ensure robust electrical connectivity under vibration, thermal cycling, and environmental exposure typical of drone operation.



Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field

• Exceptional problem-solving skills

• Design of multi-layer PCBs for flight-critical and payload functions including motor control, power distribution, sensor fusion, and communication interfaces

• Develop schematics and PCB layouts using industry-standard EDA tools (e.g., Altium Designer, KiCad, or Cadence)

• Perform design rule checks (DRC) and electrical rule checks (ERC) prior to fab release

• Define and manage stackup configurations for impedance control and high-speed signal routing

• Apply EMI best practices throughout PCB layout including ground plane strategy, decoupling, and trace routing to minimize radiated and conducted emissions

• Create and maintain component libraries, footprints, and design templates

• Ability to read and produce professional-quality schematics, PCB fabrication packages, and wiring documentation

• Good verbal and written communication skills in English



Preferred Qualifications:

• Advanced degree in engineering or related field

• BLDC motor system design

• Modeling and simulation



This position is an hourly job with deliverables every month.  Successful execution of milestone objectives in monthly deliverables will determine if continued work will be required from the job candidate.   The duration of this job can be long term with successful execution of milestones.  



This position is fully remote with flexible work times.  Occasional meetings in the Central Time Zone will be required.



Pay rate will be based on education, skills, and experience.

This role is built around responsiveness, not fixed hours. You'll work mostly within Australian business hours (AEST). Some days you might have nothing between 11am and 3pm. But if something lands at 8pm that needs action, you jump on it. If that flexibility excites you, keep reading. If you want a rigid schedule and a clean log-off time, this isn't for you — no hard feelings.

title: Remote Bookkeeper / Bookkeeping Assistant — QuickBooks Online (long-term)
description:
REMOTE BOOKKEEPER / BOOKKEEPING ASSISTANT — Functional Nutriments (Team Dog)



THE SHORT VERSION

We're a small group of U.S.-based, dog-focused companies looking for a sharp, dependable bookkeeper to work alongside our senior bookkeeper of nearly ten years. You'll own the day-to-day transactional work in QuickBooks Online across four related entities, so she can focus on the close, the reconciliations, and the judgment calls. This is a long-term, fully remote role for someone who chose accounting on purpose and takes quiet pride in books that tie out to the penny.



WHO WE ARE

Functional Nutriments makes science-backed supplements for dogs. We're part of a small family of related businesses: a dog supplement company, an independent dog-health information site, a podcast network for dog lovers, and a publishing imprint.



Our people (we think of ourselves as "Team Dog") are all fully remote professionals who live across several countries and time zones. We've operated this way for over twenty years. We're real and findable. (You're encouraged to look us up.) We treat the people who work with us like long-term partners. Some have been here for over a decade. 



WHAT YOU'LL DO



*  Categorize bank and credit-card feed transactions in QuickBooks Online, correctly and consistently

*  Enter accounts-payable bills and accounts-receivable invoices

*  Pull monthly revenue reports from Shopify, Amazon, Stripe, and PayPal and prep them for reconciliation

*  Vendor and W-9 administration, receipt collection, and document filing

*  Reconciliation prep and running reports for the senior bookkeeper's review

*  Flag anything that looks off — and ask before you guess



You will not be alone. A senior bookkeeper reviews the work and there's a clear escalation path. We want someone who can grow into more over time.



WHAT WE GENUINELY NEED 

    (please read this part >>>)

The single most important thing: you actually understand double-entry bookkeeping, not just the software. You know why undeposited funds exists, what a prepaid expense is and how it amortizes, why a refund doesn't go to the same account as a sale, and what to do when a deposit has no matching invoice. If a step exists, you understand why it exists. We'll happily teach you our books; we can't teach you bookkeeping itself.



Required:



*  Solid working grasp of double-entry fundamentals (accrual basis, debits/credits, accruals, prepaids, the matching principle)

*  At least 2 years of hands-on bookkeeping experience, including real QuickBooks Online work where you have owned the monthly books or close for at least one business (not just isolated data entry)

*  Strong, clear written English — you'll communicate mostly in writing but video calls are a real thing within Team Dog

*  Real attention to detail and the discipline to leave a clean audit trail

*  Reliability and good async communication: you do what you say, and you flag problems early

*  A quiet home work setup and stable internet and power



Nice to have (not required):



*  E-commerce bookkeeping experience (Shopify, Amazon, Stripe, PayPal, Wise)

*  Experience with multiple entities or intercompany transactions

*  QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification



THE DETAILS



*  Long-term independent contractor, fully remote

*  About 20 hours/week to start, with genuine room to grow toward full-time

*  USD$500-$700/month ($6 to $8/hour) depending on experience, with room to grow; paid twice per month via Wise

*  Flexible schedule, with some overlap with U.S. Pacific/Hawaii hours for monthly close



HOW TO APPLY — AND HOW WE HIRE

We keep this simple and human:



1.  Apply here with your resume and a few sentences about your bookkeeping experience and why this role fits you. Include the word "ledger" in your note so we know you read the full post. Bonus points if you tell us about a special dog in your life.



2.  A short online skills screen (about 20 minutes, free). If your note and background look like a fit, we'll send you a personal message with a link to a quick, auto-graded screen covering bookkeeping fundamentals and QuickBooks — with a welcome video from our founder, so you know exactly who you're dealing with.



3.  A paid working interview. Our strongest candidates do a short, paid working session with us. PLUS you'll be compensated for your time as we walk through a real-world scenario and hear how you think.



A real company, a real person on the other end, and we pay you for the practical stage. We're hiring one person and we intend to keep them for years. If that's the role you're looking for, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Sales Support/ Project Coordinator
description:
THE ROLE

You are the person who makes sure no lead dies in the pipeline and no estimate gets delayed because the CEO is stretched thin. You sit between the lead coming in and the contract getting signed, and you own that middle. You are not closing deals — that is the CEO's job. But you are doing everything that makes it possible for the CEO to show up to that close prepared, on time, and with a polished proposal already built.

This role requires someone who is professional on the phone, sharp with details, and relentless about follow-through. If a lead goes cold on your watch because nobody followed up, that is on you. If an estimate goes out late because the prep work was not done, that is on you. This is a high-accountability role with direct impact on company revenue.



YOUR CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Estimate Coordination



When a new lead comes in, pull the property address, research it (Google Maps, county appraisal records, Zillow), and build a pre-filled estimate shell with all available project info before the CEO sits down to price it

Manage the estimate tracker — every active estimate has a status, a follow-up date, and an owner

Send completed estimates to clients via GHL or
, confirm receipt, and log the send

Follow up on unsent or pending estimates and flag anything sitting longer than 48 hours



Lead Follow-Up



Every inbound lead that does not respond within 24 hours gets a follow-up call or message from you — not a bot, a real human conversation

Execute a minimum 5-touch follow-up sequence per lead: call, text,
, call, final close-out

Log every touchpoint inside GoHighLevel CRM with accurate notes and next steps

Flag hot leads, dead leads, and stalled leads to the CEO daily — no surprises



Client Communication Support



Handle routine client communication: sending contracts for e-signature, following up on unsigned documents, answering basic project status questions

Manage the CEO's client-facing inbox for both TEC and GCS — draft responses for review or send pre-approved responses independently

Keep clients informed on project milestones without the CEO having to initiate every update



Vendor & Subcontractor Coordination



Make outbound calls to vendors and subs for pricing, availability, and lead times

Compile and organize pricing responses into a clean format for the CEO to review

Follow up on unanswered vendor requests and maintain a vendor contact log



Pipeline & Calendar Management



Own the sales pipeline inside GHL — every lead is tagged correctly, staged accurately, and moving

Schedule site visits, consultations, and follow-up calls on the CEO's calendar

Send appointment confirmations and reminders to clients 24 hours before scheduled visits

Produce a daily pipeline snapshot: new leads, active estimates, follow-ups due, and next actions



WHAT YOU MUST KNOW — NON-NEGOTIABLE

Do not apply without real experience in ALL of the following:



GoHighLevel (GHL) — pipelines, contact management, notes, tasks, and basic workflow triggers. You will live in this system daily.

Professional phone communication in English — you will be calling Houston-area homeowners, property managers, vendors, and subcontractors. Your English must be clear, professional, and confident. This is non-negotiable.

 writing — professional, clean, client-facing. No grammar errors. No awkward phrasing. You represent a luxury brand.

Google Workspace — Docs, Sheets, Gmail, Calendar. You will use all of them every day.

Basic research skills — pulling property data, appraiser records, Zillow, Google Maps. You need to be comfortable finding information independently.

Extreme attention to detail — estimates involve real numbers with real financial consequences. A wrong quantity or missed line item costs money. You must be precise.



NICE TO HAVE



Experience in construction, home services, remodeling, landscaping, or trades

Familiarity with construction estimate formats or project scopes

Experience with DocuSign or similar e-signature platforms

Basic familiarity with Canva for formatting client-facing documents

Bilingual English/Spanish — a genuine advantage for vendor and subcontractor calls in Houston



WHO WILL THRIVE HERE



You are a natural communicator — clients feel taken care of when they talk to you

You are obsessive about follow-through — you do not let things fall through the cracks

You treat the CEO's time as a non-renewable resource and protect it aggressively

You think ahead — you see what is coming next and prepare for it without being asked

You are available and responsive during US Central Time business hours

You take ownership — if something slips, you own it, fix it, and tell the CEO what happened



WHO WILL NOT THRIVE HERE



People who are passive — waiting to be told what to do instead of seeing what needs to happen

People who are uncomfortable on the phone — this role requires real calls to real people daily

People who treat follow-up as optional — in this role, follow-up is the job

People who disappear when things get busy — that is exactly when we need you most

Anyone who cannot write a professional client-facing
 without multiple corrections



COMPENSATION & SCHEDULE



Pay: $600–$900/month USD based on experience — paid weekly

Hours: Full-time, 40 hrs/week

Must be available US Central Time business hours — calls happen during business hours, not whenever is convenient for you

30-day paid trial. Performance review and raise opportunity at 90 days.

Start: Immediate

title: Senior Accountant (Permanent WFH)
description:
About Safari One



Safari One Business Solutions supports the core operations of Safari Micro, a U.S.-based IT hardware and software reseller founded in 1997 and headquartered in Chandler, Arizona.



We've been operating in the Philippines since 2013 with a fully remote setup — and zero plans to return to an office. Our Philippines-based team manages accounting, finance, operations, and technical support for Safari Micro’s U.S. business.



We only hire people who are responsible, kind, skilled and fun to work with.



You will work closely with our Senior Accountant (who is whip smart, fun to work with, and an Excel whiz!) learning our accounting systems, managing end-to-end books, and contributing directly to operational decisions. You will work during our night shift in the Philippines, which is approximately 11 pm – 8 am, local Philippines time.



Why You’ll Want This Role



???? Permanent WFH setup



???? Real exposure to U.S. GAAP/IFRS and intercompany accounting



???? Modern ERP: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central



???? Paid training + certifications based on business needs and career goals



???? No micromanagement, no drama, just competent and kind coworkers



What You’ll Be Doing



You’ll start with core processes and gradually take full ownership of end-to-end accounting tasks — from daily entries to month-end close. You’ll be deeply hands-on, but also expected to grow into a leadership role, mentoring others and improving processes along the way.



Daily & Weekly Tasks



• Issue client invoices across U.S. entities



• Build and update cash flow forecasts



• Post and reconcile intercompany invoices



• Review payroll entries (Philippines)



• Validate vendor/client invoice details



Monthly & Quarterly Tasks



• Generate job costing and gross profit reports



• Analyze and reconcile AP/AR aging and vendor ledgers



• Post month-end journal entries and accruals



• Close month-end books and bank transactions



• Review U.S. payroll and sales commission data



• Manage state sales & use tax filings



• Prepare monthly financial reports and banking requirements



• Follow up on open orders and liaise with U.S. sales reps and vendors



Who We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who loves accounting — not just someone who’s good at it.



? 5–8 years accounting experience, ideally handling U.S. books or under IFRS



? Degree in Accounting required; CPA is highly preferred



? Strong English communication: Can explain accounting concepts clearly and concisely over
 or VOIP



? Detail-obsessed: Can catch discrepancies others miss



? Self-directed and accountable — owns mistakes, fixes them, learns fast



?Comfortable taking ownership of processes and mentoring junior tea
mbers as the role expands



? Friendly, drama-free team player who enjoys remote collaboration



Nice-to-Have



• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central



• Prior experience working with U.S. entities or accounting teams



• Strong Excel modeling and reconciliation skills



• Has led or supervised accounting teams or processes, such as month-end close or audit preparation



Compensation & Benefits



???? Very competitive pay, based on your experience (includes 10% night shift differential)



????? Brand new WFH gear (laptop, monitor, headset)



???? HMO + 1 dependent (medical & dental)



???? 13th month pay + year-end bonus



?????15 PTO days/year + Birthday Leave + U.S. Holidays



???? Paid certifications + training



If your background matches and you’re ready to own a key piece of a U.S. company’s accounting engine, apply now!

title: Occupancy and Lettings Sales Manager
description:
Job Title: Occupancy and Lettings Sales Manager

Location: Remote (Philippines-based)

Hours: Full-time, aligned to UK working hours

Working Schedule: Monday to Friday, 4:00 pm–9:00 pm UK time, and Saturday to Sunday, 9:00 am–6:00 pm UK time with a 1-hour unpaid break each day

Total Hours: 41 hours per week

Pay Structure: Fixed monthly pay plus KPI-based and sales-based bonus

Salary: Up to £650 per month depending on experience, fit, and pay structure



About the role



We are hiring a client-facing Occupancy and Lettings Sales Manager for a UK property business covering both long-term rentals and short-stay / serviced accommodation.



This is primarily a sales and conversion role, not a general admin role. Your job is to help keep properties occupied by responding quickly to leads, following up consistently, converting enquiries into viewings, bookings, and signed deals, and supporting the move-in / booking coordination process.



You will be responsible for filling long-term rental units, supporting short-stay occupancy, progressing applicants and clients, and making sure no serious lead is lost through slow response, weak follow-up, or poor coordination.



This role is especially suited to someone who is comfortable working afternoons, evenings, and weekends and can stay responsive, organised, and commercially focused during those hours.



Minimum non-negotiable requirements



Please apply only if you meet all of the following:



Experience in sales, lettings, occupancy, bookings, reservations, or lead conversion within the property sector — at least 2 years (please note that applicants without this experience won;t be considered). 

Strong written and spoken English

Strong communication skills with tenants, guests, applicants, and clients

Experience handling leads, follow-up, and conversion without dropping tasks

Ability to work quickly and accurately across calls, messages, spreadsheets, and platforms

Strong organisational discipline

High attention to detail

Confidence in following up repeatedly and moving leads toward conversion

Availability for the exact shift listed above

Reliable internet, quiet working environment, and suitable headset for calls





Strongly preferred



Experience with UK lettings

Experience with OpenRent

Experience with short-stay / Airbnb / Booking.com / serviced accommodation

Experience coordinating viewings, applicant progression, move-ins, or bookings

Experience working in a KPI-driven or target-driven role

Experience working UK or US late shifts previously



What this role is responsible for



Responding to new tenant and guest leads quickly

Following up all live leads across calls, messages,
, and relevant platforms

Converting enquiries into viewings, bookings, and progressed applications

Coordinating and confirming viewings

Progressing applicants and bookings to the next stage

Supporting move-ins and short-stay check-in / booking coordination where needed

Helping maintain occupancy across long-term and short-stay properties

Updating sheets, trackers, notes, and CRM records accurately

Escalating only where necessary and keeping live leads moving until outcome



What success looks like



Leads are responded to quickly

Viewings are arranged and confirmed properly

Applicants and bookings are progressed without delay

Properties stay occupied and void periods are reduced

Short-stay occupancy is maintained or improved

No serious lead is left without proper follow-up

Notes, trackers, and records stay accurate and updated

Communication is professional, warm, efficient, and commercially effective

Sales targets, occupancy targets, and KPI standards are met



Pay structure



This role includes:



fixed monthly pay

KPI-based bonus

sales / conversion bonus



Bonus and KPI structure will depend on:



lead response speed

follow-up consistency

viewing and booking progression

conversion into lets / bookings

occupancy performance

quality of notes, tracking, and record keeping



Important



This is not only a messaging role. It is a sales role that requires:



strong sales skills and mindset

effective and warm communication

excellent English skills

strong follow-up

conversion mindset

confidence on calls and messages

good coordination

discipline with notes and records

ability to keep multiple live conversations and leads moving at the same time



If you are slow to respond, do not like follow-up work, or struggle with sales discipline and conversion-focused coordination, this role is probably not the right fit.



To apply



Please send:



Your CV

A short cover message

A short summary of your experience in:

sales / lead handling / conversion

lettings / bookings / reservations / occupancy

viewings / applicant progression / move-ins

short-stay or hospitality coordination, if any



Please also state:



whether you have worked UK late shifts before

which systems / platforms you have used

your expected monthly salary in GBP

Application process



1. To apply, please include this exact phrase in your application subject line:



Occupancy Sales Role – Fast Follow-Up and Detail-Focused



Applications without this exact subject line will not be considered.



2. In your application or cover
, please answer this question:



What evidence do you have that you can manage high volumes of live leads, follow up consistently, and convert enquiries into viewings, bookings, or signed deals during evening and weekend shifts?



3. Attach your CV as per the guidance above.

title: Video Editor
description:
Counter Culture Productions is a boutique cinematic content studio specializing in short-form brand storytelling for regional and national clients. We produce commercials, social media reels, and advertising content that earns attention — not just fills a feed. We're looking for an editor who understands that every cut is a decision about meaning, not just timing.



You're not waiting to be told what the story is. You watch the footage, you find it. You have a developed sense of narrative arc — you know where tension lives, where the release needs to happen, and how to build a sequence that carries a viewer from curiosity to conviction without them knowing why they're hooked. You've watched enough great work — film, documentary, commercial — that pacing is intuitive to you. You don't just assemble clips. You build an experience.



Take raw footage from cinematic brand shoots and shape it into polished short-form content (60 sec) with minimal direction.



Develop and execute a narrative arc independently — rough cut to final with a clear editorial point of view.



Build pacing that serves the brand's emotional tone: sometimes kinetic, sometimes slow and deliberate, always intentional.



Color grade or work alongside a colorist to maintain visual consistency and cinematic feel.



Cut to music with a strong sense of rhythm and breath — not just on the beat.



Integrate AI-assisted tools (upscaling, audio cleanup, background generation, motion tracking, etc.) where they improve the work, not just the workflow.



Deliver client-ready 4K exports optimized for web, broadcast, and social formats.



Occasionally concept alongside the director in pre-production to flag editorial opportunities in the shot list.

title: Inbound Sales & Customer Care Representative With Excellent English
description:
Inbound Sales & Customer Care Representative With Excellent English



U.S. Home Services / Septic Company | Remote Contractor Role



Company Open Water Septic Tank Services LLC — family-owned septic service company in Georgia, USA

Role Type Full-time independent contractor, phone-first customer care and inbound appointment booking

Schedule Monday-Friday, 5:00 PM-8:00 PM and Saturday-Sunday 7:00 am - 7:00 pm U.S. Eastern Time; Philippine time varies with U.S. daylight saving time

Compensation USD $500-$1,000/month base, plus possible performance bonus

Target Start As soon as the right candidate is selected



About Us

Open Water Septic is a growing family-owned septic service company based in Georgia, USA. We help homeowners and businesses with septic tank pumping, septic backups, inspections, hydrojetting, sewer camera inspections, and related service needs.



We are looking for a long-term remote tea
mber in the Philippines who can answer inbound customer calls, help customers understand our services, and book appointments accurately. This is a phone-first role for someone with excellent spoken English neutral or light accent, good judgment, and a calm, professional customer service style.



Important: This Is Inbound Sales and Customer Care — Not Cold Calling



Customers are calling us because they already need septic service. However, this is not only basic customer support. The right person must be comfortable helping ready-to-book customers get scheduled, and must also know how to explain our value when a caller is shopping around, unsure, or comparing prices.



Main Responsibilities



Phone-Based Customer Care & Booking — 60%

• Answer inbound calls from U.S. customers with warmth, confidence, and professionalism.

• Schedule septic service appointments in Jobber CRM and enter accurate customer details.

• Explain basic pricing clearly and confidently.

• Ask the right questions about the customer’s issue, location, tank size, timing, and access.

• Help customers understand why Open Water Septic is a strong choice when they are comparing providers.

• Send follow-up texts and
s to customers who requested pricing but did not book.

• Coordinate with the owner and field technician so service details are clear before arrival.

• Process basic payment and billing questions according to company instructions.



Administrative Support — 20%

• Keep organized notes, customer records, and follow-up tasks.

• Assist with unpaid invoice follow-up and simple reports.

• Help improve scripts, templates, and customer communication over time.



Social Media Support — 20%

• Prepare simple
 and Instagram posts using provided photos, service updates, and guidance.

• Respond to basic messages and route service requests quickly.

• Help organize job photos and customer review opportunities.



Service Advantages You Will Learn to Explain



Open Water Septic does more than basic septic pumping. Our service truck can bring multiple solutions to one visit, including:



• A septic pump truck for tank pump-outs.

• A hydrojetter that can blast clogs out of lines at up to 3,000 PSI and reach up to 200 feet.

• A sewer camera that can inspect lines in color and record photos/videos up to 150 feet.



This matters because some septic problems are not only a full tank. If there is a clog or line issue, we may be able to help during the same visit instead of the customer needing to call another company, pay another fee, and wait another day.



What We Are Looking For



Required Experience

• 3+ years phone-based customer service, appointment setting, inbound sales, dispatch, or BPO experience.

• Experience speaking with U.S., Canadian, Australian, or U.K. customers.

• Experience working night shift or U.S. business hours from the Philippines.

• CRM experience preferred; Jobber experience is a plus.

• Home services, plumbing, HVAC, pest control, roofing, garage door, or similar service company experience is a strong plus.



Spoken English Requirement

• Strong spoken English is required because this role involves live phone calls with U.S. customers. No accent or light accent required.

• You must be easy for U.S. callers to understand over the phone.

• You must be able to understand customers without repeatedly asking them to repeat themselves.

• You must be able to explain pricing and service benefits naturally, not just read a script.



Skills and Qualities

• Warm, patient, and confident phone manner.

• Comfortable asking for the booking when the customer is ready.

• Detail-oriented and accurate with names, addresses, phone numbers, prices, and scheduling notes.

• Able to memorize simple pricing and local service area towns.

• Reliable attendance and strong follow-through.

• Good judgment when a customer is upset, has an emergency, or needs a technician quickly.

• Willing to learn basic septic service language over time.



Technical Requirements

• Reliable computer suitable for voice calls, CRM work,
, and basic social media tasks.

• Stable internet with at least 25 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload.

• Backup internet connection, such as mobile data or a second ISP.

• Quiet workspace for professional customer calls.

• Quality headset with noise-canceling microphone.

• Ability to use phone/CRM systems,
, text messaging tools, Google Workspace, and basic design tools such as Canva.



Information You Will Be Expected to Learn



The right candidate does not need septic experience on day one. We will train you. However, you must be able to memorize and use simple information, including:



• Basic pump-out pricing, including common tank sizes.

• Which towns are in our service area.

• How to explain pump-outs, septic backups, hydrojetting, and camera inspections in simple customer-friendly language.

• How to identify when a customer is ready to book versus when they need a follow-up.



Compensation

Base Pay USD $500-$1,000/month, depending on demonstrated phone skill and experience.

Performance Bonus Possible $50-$100/month based on attendance, call quality, booking accuracy, calls converting into jobs, and customer communication.

Payment Schedule Paid twice monthly through an agreed payment platform such as Payoneer, Wise, EasyPay, or similar.

Growth Opportunity Long-term role with room for rate increases as performance and company growth support it.



Contractor Relationship

This is an independent contractor role. The contractor will:

• Complete IRS Form W-8BEN for U.S. tax purposes.

• Handle their own Philippine tax obligations.

• Use their own equipment, internet connection, and workspace.

• Be paid a flat contracted monthly rate plus any earned bonus.



We provide clear expectations, training on our systems, regular feedback, and a stable long-term opportunity with a growing U.S. service company.

How to Apply

Use this subject line:

OPEN WATER SEPTIC — [Your Name]

Please include all of the following:

1. Resume.

2. OnlineJobs.ph profile link.

3. Screenshot of internet speed test.

4. Screenshot of computer specs.

5. A 2-3 minute video recording using the script below.



Required Voice Recording Script



Please record yourself saying this naturally. Do not use AI voice tools. We are listening for clarity, confidence, pacing, warmth, and whether U.S. customers will be able to understand you easily over the phone.



“Hi, this is [Name] with Open Water Septic. I understand your septic system is backing up. We can help with that. Our standard pump-out for a 1,000-gallon tank is $500. What makes us different is that we bring more than just a pump truck. Our truck also has a hydrojetter that can blast clogs out of the line at up to 3,000 PSI, and we also have a sewer camera that can inspect the line in color up to 150 feet. That means if the problem is more than just a full tank, we may be able to help solve it during the same visit instead of you needing to call another company and wait another day.”
