title: Bookkeeper — Australian GST, BAS & Full Setup | MrYouWho — Remote (PH)
description:
Bookkeeper — Australian GST, BAS & Full Setup | MrYouWho — Remote (PH)



Pay: $4–$5.50 USD/hour

Hours: 40 hrs/week (contractor) | part-time considered for the right candidate

Location: Remote — Philippines

Start: ASAP



This is a long-term ongoing role.



IMPORTANT NOTE FOR PREVIOUS APPLICANTS



We received a high volume of applications for this role and were unable to progress everyone. We apologise for the delay. If you were in contact with us previously, please apply again with updated answers to the questions below. Previous applications will not be carried over.



About the role



We are expanding our team and this is one of the most important hires we are making.



MrYouWho is a global tech and lifestyle media network based on the Gold Coast, Australia, operating as H Media Group Pty Ltd. We run 16 YouTube channels, 14 Amazon storefronts across international markets, brand partnership deals, and two affiliate websites. Our books need to be accurate, audit-ready, and properly set up for Australian tax requirements including GST registration and BAS lodgement.



We have an Australian accountant we work with. Your job is to work alongside them — setting up our bookkeeping system from scratch, cleaning up the backlog, handling ongoing monthly close, and making sure everything is organised and ready for the accountant when needed.



This starts immediately and is a long-term role. We need someone who can own this function properly, not someone who needs constant supervision.



What you'll be doing



Setup and System



- Set up QuickBooks, MYOB, or Xero — recommend the best fit and implement it properly

- Build a clean chart of accounts suited to a media and YouTube content business

- Establish a consistent receipt and invoice capture system

- Create a repeatable weekly and monthly process the founder can rely on



Backlog and Catch-Up



- Import and reconcile bank statements including all backlog

- Enter and categorise all income and expenses correctly

- Attach receipts and invoices to every transaction

- Get books to a clean state ready to hand to the accountant for last financial year and this financial year



Weekly Ongoing Tasks



- Capture and categorise all new transactions every week

- Collect, attach, and file all receipts and expense documentation

- Keep income and expenses current — nothing falls behind

- Generate a weekly Profit and Loss report for the founder

- Flag anything unusual or that needs attention before it becomes a problem



Australian Tax and Compliance



- Ongoing GST categorisation — correct classification of all transactions

- BAS preparation — quarterly lodgement support working alongside our accountant

- Understand the difference between GST-applicable and GST-free transactions for an Australian business

- Keep everything audit-ready at all times



Monthly Close



- Full bank reconciliation every month without being asked

- Clean monthly summary for the founder — income, expenses, outstanding, anything flagged

- Flag anything that needs accountant review

- Maintain organised folders, consistent file naming, and clear notes throughout





What we're looking for — non-negotiable



- Proven bookkeeping experience — not admin who has used accounting software, actual bookkeeping

- Hands-on experience with Australian businesses including GST categorisation and BAS preparation

- Strong QuickBooks, MYOB, or Xero experience — must be able to set up and run the system, not just use it

- High accuracy and consistency — our books are critical and errors have real consequences

- Ability to work with messy backlogs and get them clean without losing detail

- Comfortable working alongside an Australian accountant

- Long-term mindset — this is not a short project





Highly regarded



- Experience bookkeeping for Australian sole traders, PTY LTD companies, or media businesses

- Familiarity with Amazon seller income, brand deal invoicing, and multi-currency transactions

- Experience setting up bookkeeping systems from scratch rather than inheriting an existing one





Be honest about your experience



We will verify your experience during the trial. The process is quick — screening questions, short interview, paid trial task, then start. If the trial reveals the experience is not what you described, we move on. This is a critical role and we need someone who is genuinely qualified. Be straightforward.



About MrYouWho



- Global tech and lifestyle media network based on the Gold Coast, Australia

- Operating entity: H Media Group Pty Ltd

- 16 YouTube channels + 14 Amazon storefronts across international markets

- Brand partnership deals, affiliate revenue, and YouTube ad revenue

- 280,000+ subscribers network-wide

- $1.25M+ in Amazon-attributed sales in 2025



Primary channel: 
/mryouwho



Our hiring process



- You answer the screening questions below

- Short initial interview (20–30 minutes)

- Paid trial task

- Second interview to confirm fit

- Start



We move quickly but we take this role seriously. If you are the right person the process will be straightforward.



How to apply



Quick Apply and CV-only applications will not be reviewed. Answer all four questions in order. Skip one and your application will not be read.



In your subject line or opening line write: Australian Experience — [how many years]. Applications without this will not be reviewed.



1. What bookkeeping tools have you used — QuickBooks, MYOB, Xero, or other? For each tool, describe the type of business you used it for and what you were responsible for. Give at least 3 examples.

2. Do you have hands-on experience with Australian GST categorisation and BAS preparation? Describe specifically what you did, for which type of business, and how often you lodged BAS.

3. How do you approach a backlog cleanup and reconciliation from scratch? Wak us through your process step by step.

4. What does your monthly close deliverable look like for a founder? What does the founder receive from you at the end of each month?



Add the word DETAILS at the end of your application.

title: Senior Automation & Web Developer — Zapier / Airtable / APIs / WordPress / GTM / AI
description:
About Us



We're a fast-growing Australian business finance company. We're a lean team that competes through automation — our tech stack does the work of 100 people, and we're hiring one senior person to own, extend, and improve it full-time. (Company details shared with shortlisted candidates at interview stage.)



This is NOT a VA role and NOT a junior dev role. You'll be the technical builder for the business, working directly with the owner (who built the current systems and knows them deeply — you won't be guessing alone).



Our Stack (you'll work across most of this)



-Zapier (advanced: code steps, webhooks, paths, error handling — not just simple Zaps)

-Airtable (automations, scripting, complex base design, API)

-Pipedrive CRM (API, webhooks, workflow automation)

-ActiveCampaign (automations, API)

-Python (Flask services deployed on Google Cloud Run)

-REST APIs generally — reading API docs and building reliable integrations is the core of this job

-LLM integrations (Claude / OpenAI APIs — building automations that use AI models via API)

-WordPress — custom code (PHP/HTML/CSS/JS), performance optimisation (Core Web Vitals), and ongoing site management. Not just themes and plugins — you must be able to work in the code.

-Google Tag Manager & tracking — GTM container setup, dataLayer coding, UTM parameter architecture, conversion tracking (including server-side / Conversions API)

-Cloudflare, DNS, domains & hosting — DNS records, security settings, SSL, domain management (GoDaddy etc.), hosting environments

-Softr (client portal on top of Airtable)

-Plus: SMS APIs (Twilio/Sinch), Meta Conversions API, and AI voice APIs



You don't need experience with every tool — but you MUST be strong on Zapier + Airtable + APIs + Python + WordPress (real coding, not just plugins), and able to learn the rest fast from documentation.



What You'll Do



-Build new automations and improve existing ones (lead routing, CRM workflows, client notifications, and LLM-powered automation systems)

-Own our WordPress website end-to-end: performance (Core Web Vitals), custom code changes, design polish, and reliability

-Own our tracking infrastructure: GTM, dataLayer, UTM architecture, and conversion tracking accuracy across Meta and Google

-Manage the infrastructure layer: Cloudflare, DNS, domains, hosting, SSL, and security settings

-Innovate with AI. We use LLMs heavily across our systems and expect you to stay current with new models, tools, and techniques — and to proactively propose where AI can improve or replace existing processes. "I saw this new capability and built a prototype" is the energy we pay bonuses for.

-Debug production issues by finding root causes — not patching symptoms

-Integrate third-party APIs by reading official documentation carefully and verifying exact parameter specs (this is a hard requirement for us — guessing at API parameters is how systems break)

-Write clear documentation: every automation you ship comes with a written spec and runbook. No exceptions.

-Proactively identify problems and improvements before being asked — we pay bonuses specifically for this



Compensation



-Base: USD $2,500–3,000/month depending on experience

-Monthly performance bonus: USD $300–800 based on shipped systems that run reliably, documentation quality, and -proactive problem-finding. Opportunity to go even higher, based on performance.

-Annual base increases for strong performers

-Long-term, stable, full-time role — we are building for years, not months



Hours Of Work



Full-time, Monday–Friday, working - 9am - 6pm SYDNEY TIME.



Who This Role Suits



-5+ years building automations, integrations, and websites professionally — you're a senior generalist who's comfortable owning the entire technical surface of a business, not a specialist in one tool

-You're a problem solver and have a high degree of attention to detail

-You chase root causes, not symptoms — "I found why it breaks" instead of "I added a workaround"

-You read API documentation for fun (or at least without pain)

-You're genuinely excited by AI — you already use LLMs in your own workflow, follow new releases, and have built things with -AI APIs because you wanted to, not just because a client asked

-You test your own work before calling it done

-You communicate clearly and proactively — if something is blocked or broken, we hear it from you first

-You want one stable long-term client who pays well and pays bonuses, not five gigs



Who This Role Does NOT Suit



-Anyone whose Zapier experience is limited to simple two-step Zaps

-Anyone whose WordPress experience is page builders only (Elementor/Divi) — if you can't work directly in PHP/HTML/CSS/JS and diagnose performance issues in the code, this isn't your role

-Anyone who hardcodes credentials or guesses at API parameters instead of checking docs

-Anyone juggling multiple clients (we require exclusivity during work hours)

-Agencies, teams, or anyone planning to subcontract any part of this work. We are hiring you, one individual — the person we interview is the person who does the work, always. Given the financial data our systems handle, subcontracting is treated as a serious breach and grounds for immediate termination.

-Anyone uncomfortable with logged/audited system access — we run strict security practices (scoped credentials, audit trails). Honest builders find this boring; that's the point.



Security Note (read this — it matters)



We work with financial data, so we follow least-privilege access practices: you'll use your own named accounts and scoped API keys, production credentials are managed by the owner, and system activity is logged. This is standard, professional, and protects you as much as us. If that sounds reasonable, we'll get along great.



SKILL REQUIREMENTS



Required:



-Zapier (Expert)

-Airtable (Expert)

-AI Tool Use — Claude Code / ChatGPT (Expert)

-API Integration / REST APIs (Expert)

-WordPress — custom code & performance (Advanced)

-Google Tag Manager / UTM / conversion tracking (Advanced)

-Python (Advanced)

-HTML / CSS / JavaScript (Advanced)

-Webhooks (Advanced)

-Cloudflare / DNS / domain & hosting management (Intermediate–Advanced)



Strongly preferred:



-Pipedrive or similar CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce)

-ActiveCampaign or similar (Mailchimp, Klaviyo)

-Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions)

-Flask or similar Python web frameworks

-Meta Conversions API / server-side tracking



Nice to have:



-Softr / no-code app builders

-Twilio / Sinch / Kixie, SMS APIs

-SQL





HOW TO APPLY



To apply, send a message that includes ALL of the following — applications missing any item will not be read:



1. Start your message with the word "PINEAPPLE" so we know you read the full post.



2. Your 2–3 best automation/integration projects — for each: what it did, which tools/APIs were involved, and one problem you hit and how you solved it. Specific detail matters more than polish. Include links wherever possible — live websites you've built or optimised, GitHub, portfolio, or Loom walkthroughs. Claims we can verify are worth far more than claims we can't.



3. Answer this question: A Zapier webhook step is receiving data from a third-party API, but one field arrives blank for about 4% of records even though the source system shows the data exists. Describe, step by step, how you would diagnose this. (There is no single right answer — we're looking at how you think.)



4. Answer this question: A WordPress landing page scores poorly on Core Web Vitals (high CLS, slow LCP) and its Meta conversion tracking is undercounting leads. Briefly: what are the first things you'd check for each problem?



5. Your expected monthly salary in USD.



6. Confirm you can work 9:00am–6:00pm Sydney time (including the earlier Manila start during Australian daylight saving) full-time and exclusively.



7. A short video introduction (3–5 minutes, camera on) — Loom or similar. Briefly: who you are, what you've built that you're proudest of, and what specifically about this role appeals to you. No script needed, no editing, no polish — we just want to meet the actual person we'd be talking to every morning.



If you're selected, we'll contact you back to arrange a quick interview to see if we're a good fit to work together.

Senior QA/QC Architect 



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM Pacific Time, with a 30-minute break

Salary: $1,200 per month



Job Overview: 

We are seeking a Senior QA/QC Architect based in the Philippines to provide quality assurance and quality control oversight for architectural drawings produced by our drafting team. This role will focus on reviewing drawings, identifying coordination issues, and ensuring that all documentation meets technical and constructability standards before project delivery.

The ideal candidate is a licensed architect with strong experience working in reputable architectural firms on complex projects, with deep expertise in technical detailing, multidisciplinary coordination, and drawing review.



* Key Responsibilities:

Perform QA/QC reviews of architectural drawings produced by the drafting and production teams.

Identify nonconformance issues, coordination conflicts, and detailing errors within project drawings.

Review coordination between Architectural, Structural, and MEP consultant drawings.

Ensure drawings meet constructability requirements and professional architectural standards.

Provide clear feedback and correction notes to the drafting team to improve drawing accuracy and consistency.

Help maintain quality standards across projects and reduce repetitive corrections.

Ensure lessons learned from previous projects are applied to future projects to improve overall drawing quality.

Review and validate technical details and construction documentation before final submission.

Support internal teams by ensuring drawings follow company standards and project documentation requirements.



* Training & Standards

The selected candidate will be trained on the company’s storage system detailing standards and internal documentation processes to ensure alignment with project requirements.



* Qualifications:

Licensed Architect (Philippines) required

Minimum 6+ years of architectural experience in a reputable architectural firm

Experience working on complex architectural projects

Strong expertise in architectural detailing and construction documentation

Strong understanding of coordination between Architectural, Structural, and MEP disciplines

Ability to identify constructability and coordination issues within drawings



* Technical Skills:

Strong experience reviewing drawings in Revit

Working knowledge of AutoCAD

Ability to review and coordinate multi-disciplinary drawing sets



* Additional Requirements

Candidates must be able to provide examples of previous projects they have worked on

Strong attention to detail and problem-solving ability

Excellent ability to review and critique drawing packages for technical accuracy



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: Editor for a Moto-Vlog Style YouTube Channel
description:
I THINK WE MISSED A TURN: Editor for a Moto-Vlog Style YouTube Channel - TCAT Remapping Expedition 2026



Editor for a Moto-Vlog Style YouTube Channel

OVERVIEW

- Craig Luke is a Canadian Moto-Vlogger based in Nelson, British Columbia. He is currently riding solo, coast to coast off-road, to remap the Trans Canada Adventure Trail. 15,000 km from Grant Bay on Vancouver Island to St. John's, Newfoundland. Roughly six months on the dirt road. You are the editor who turns each journey's raw footage into a finished, upload-ready video.

- This is off-road adventure motorcycling content made by riders for riders. Authentic and practical. Real Canadian backcountry travel, not influencer polish. He shoots on a lightweight Kove 450 Rally and lives on a strict $50/day budget. Footage comes off the trail and uploads via Starlink Mini from remote campsites. Every video should feel like the viewer is out there with him.

- Style benchmark is Itchy Boots 
 story-driven pacing built around solo travel, geographic progression, map tracking and the raw beauty of the trail. Not hyper-edited visual noise.

- Publish cadence is once every three days to start. Turnaround is within 48 hours from the moment a journey's assets are ready.



THE ROLE

- We outline each episode in a shared Google Sheet. An episode may cover one day or several days. You build one finished episode per outline.

- We engage you video by video to start.

- If we like your work and we are working well together, we build a longer-term relationship from there.

- We want a go-to editor for the entire 15,000km project across Canada and beyond.

- The production hub is this Google Sheet: 



REVIEW THE CHANNEL FIRST

- Watch the current channel for context and style: 

- We want you to match the rider-to-rider feel and then raise the bar.

- Come with ideas. Better pacing, cleaner sound design, sharper color, smarter cutaways, stronger hooks and openings, chapter markers, retention editing.

- Tell us what you would do differently and why.



REFERENCE VIDEOS (watch before you start)

- Study these before your first edit. They show the target. Match the pacing, energy and storytelling. Do not copy shot for shot.

- Style we are aiming for: youtu.be/t8R4xB9k6xI

- Reference: youtu.be/6cmY8qEdvIM

- Channel benchmark: Itchy Boots, 



SOURCE FOOTAGE

- Craig shoots each day on three cameras.

- Insta360 X4 Air. 360 capture for reframing and impossible angles. 8K.

- Insta360 GO Ultra. Mounted POV and cube shots.

- Phone. Handheld and talking-to-camera footage.



WHERE EVERYTHING LIVES

- Google Sheet (production hub). Every episode outlines lives here. The narrative spine, titles, descriptions, tags, notes, locations and track links. An outline may span multiple days. This is your starting point for every episode.

- Google Drive day folders. Raw footage from the three cameras, photos of people and scenery, Craig's voiceover and in most cases the route map video file.

- 
. The route map is usually dropped into the Drive folder as a finished video. In some cases over the next two weeks you may need to grab the route video for the day from 
 yourself. Craig is moving toward providing it automatically in the folder.

- Insta360 Studio app. Where you reframe and export the 360 footage before Premiere, or you use the Insta360 plugin inside Premiere instead.



THE 360 WORKFLOW

- You handle the 360 footage one of two ways.

- Reframe and export the 360 footage in the Insta360 Studio app first, then bring it into Adobe Premiere Pro.

- Or use the Adobe Premiere Pro Insta360 plugin to import and reframe the .insv files directly inside Premiere.

- Pick the path your machine handles cleanly. Everything finishes in Premiere.



WHAT YOU BUILD

- One finished episode per outline.

- The route map worked into the video. Most days the map video is already in the Drive folder. Occasionally you pull it from 
.

- Craig's voiceover laid in as the spine of the story.

- The pre-made intro and outro applied to every video.

- People and scenery photos worked in as cutaways and b-roll where they fit the story.



EDIT APPROACH

- Follow the outline in the Google Sheet as the spine. It tells you where Craig was, where he was going and what happened.

- Cut for story first, polish second. The ride is the star. Find the arc. Geographic progress, the struggle, the breakdown, the triumph, the camp routine.

- Keep it honest. No fake drama. Sound like a rider, not a brand.

- Reframe the X4 360 footage to land the action. Use the small POV cam for mounted shots. Use the phone for Craig to camera.

- Pacing and sound design. Balance voiceover and music against crisp engine audio, wind and ambient nature sound. Build tension on technical trail. Go cinematic and calm at camp. The voice stays clear and on top.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND HARDWARE

- Expert editor in Adobe Premiere Pro. This is the only editor we use. We want every project built in Premiere so we can bring editing in-house later.

- Insta360 workflow. Reframe and stabilize 360 footage cleanly. Run the Insta360 Reframe plugin in Premiere or reframe and export in the Insta360 Studio app first.

- Handle heavy 4K and 8K files smoothly.

- Audio layering and sound design. Balance voiceover, camera audio, engine sound and music so the voice stays crystal clear.

- Story editing. Find the narrative arc in hours of raw trail footage without over-editing. The Itchy Boots flow.

- Strong English comprehension. You follow written outlines and check on-screen metadata against what actually happened on camera.

- Reliable communication and on-time delivery inside the 48 hour window.

- Fast internet and a high-spec machine. You will pull heavy 8K and 4K files from Google Drive and the Insta360 cloud.



NICE TO HAVE (strong bonus, not required)

- Map and motion graphics. Generate route paths from GPX using Google Earth Studio, After Effects or a dedicated mapping plugin. In most cases the route map is provided for you. Relive supplies the motion graphics if they come on as a sponsor. Otherwise we build it through Google Maps or another option. This is a real plus if you can do it.

- After Effects for titles, lower thirds and clean motion graphics.

- Color grading in Lumetri.

- Thumbnail design.

- Experience editing travel, moto, outdoor or adventure content.



WHAT WE LOOK FOR IN YOU

- Detail focused. You catch the small things.

- Self-managed. We do not track your hours. You hold the milestones and the quality.

- A storyteller, not just a button pusher.

- In it for the long haul. We want one editor for the whole expedition.



DELIVERY AND APPROVAL



- Drop two files back into the journey's Google Drive folder. The Adobe Premiere master project file (once approved and finalized) and the finished video file.

- Do not upload anything to YouTube. We handle that ourselves for now. We bring you into that once we have worked together for a while.

- Use the title, description and tags from the Google Sheet. If Craig covered something on camera that was not in the outline, update the metadata to match what actually happened.

- Tell us the episode is ready for review. All of this inside the 48 hour turnaround window.



COMPENSATION AND WORK TERMS



- We are a Canadian company. All pay is in Canadian dollars (CAD).

- Structure. Paid per completed video. One finished longform episode, 15 to 20 minutes.

- Trial rate. $65 CAD per video for your first 3 videos. This is a paid trial so we both confirm the fit.

- Standard rate. $100 CAD per video from video 4 onward, once the trial passes review and we are working well together.

- Growth bonus. When the channel hits 20,000 subscribers you earn a bonus on every video on top of your per-video rate.

- Performance bonus. Once the channel revenue grows we add a bonus tied to views on the videos you personally edit. This is added to your base, never in place of it.

- Monthly retainer. When the channel is profitable we are willing to move you to a monthly retainer plus bonuses.

- Payment schedule. Paid after each video is completed. We move to a monthly salary when the channel hits 50,000 subscribers. Paid in CAD.

- Flexibility. We do not track your hours. You manage your own schedule as long as the milestones and quality hold for each delivery.

- Long-term potential. We want one go-to editor for the full 15,000km project across Canada and beyond.



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully)

- We only hire people who pay attention to detail. Automated or copy-pasted applications get ignored. In your application include the items below.

- The secret phrase. Start your message with this exact line: "I found the turn! - ITWMAT Video Editor".

- Your portfolio. Links to YouTube or adventure content you personally edited. Include examples with maps or heavy voiceover.

- Production ideas. After watching the channel, name two or three specific things you would do to raise the production quality.

- Your project rate. Confirm our per-video structure works, or give your target rate in CAD per 15 to 20 minute finished video.

- Your gear and connection. A short description of your computer specs and a screenshot of your internet download and upload speed.



NEXT STEP

- Watch both reference videos and the current channel, then reply with your questions on the open specs and your production ideas so we can lock everything before the first folder lands.

title: Brand Strategist
description:
**PLEASE CAREFULLY READ ALL THE DETAILS BEFORE APPLYING***



Job Title: Brand Strategist

Work Type: 

Remote/WFH

Full-time 

Working Hours: TBD (Usually US Hours/Night shift)

Start Date: TBD



ABOUT US: 



We are a brand strategy agency built on a simple principle: business clarity, built to convert. We extract what's true about a business and build the strategy and tools that turn that truth into measurable growth. We don't do marketing theater — we do truth-extraction and strategy that actually moves the needle.



JOB OVERVIEW:



The Role As our Brand Strategist: 



You own the strategic thinking that shapes every client engagement. You conduct deep discovery conversations with client leaders. You listen — genuinely, without agenda — to uncover what's actually true about their business. You observe what's said and unsaid. You ask questions built from listening, not from a script. You identify their real competitive advantage and the actual constraints they face.



You take what you extracted, validate it against data and research, and synthesize a clear strategic direction. You know what the business actually needs to succeed — not what sounds good, but what's true. You develop a comprehensive strategy plan: positioning, messaging, information architecture, website strategy, conversion design, and the metrics framework that proves it's working.



You translate strategy into clear, compelling deliverables — Strategy Decks, audit reports, optimization analysis, wireframe briefs, messaging frameworks, and strategic copy. You present this work to C-suite clients with authority that comes from genuine understanding and care for their success — not ego.



You partner with our Designer and Web Engineer during execution, reviewing their work for strategic alignment. After launch, you audit performance against the metrics you defined and recommend strategic optimizations.



JOB ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES: 



What You Own



Facilitation of strategic discovery conversations through deep listening

Strategic architecture: information architecture, website strategy, conversion funnel design, page prioritization, user flow

Wireframe creation that communicates strategic intent

Strategic writing: Strategy Decks, audit reports, optimization analysis, research synthesis, briefs, positioning/messaging, website copy

Metrics framework definition

Strategic review of design and copy execution

Post-launch audits and optimization analysis

Documenting learnings to build the knowledge base



JOB REQUIREMENTS:



Experience:



5+ years of direct client strategy work — extraction, research, metrics definition, strategic decisions

Proven ability to present and facilitate with C-suite (CEOs, VPs of Marketing)

Deep literacy in testing, measurement, conversion strategy

Demonstrated experience with website strategy, information architecture, conversion design

Strong strategic writing — intentional, clear, purposeful

Track record across multiple industries



Character:



Genuinely good person with integrity. Trustworthy. Respected.

Truth in your words — straight, honest, willing to admit what you don't know

Authentic curiosity about how businesses actually work

Listen more than you talk

Confident in strategy grounded in truth, but humble enough to learn from data

Zero ego. Your care for client success is bigger than your need to be right.

Growth Minded



Core Capabilities:



Deep listening combined with strong facilitation

Ability to ask powerful questions that reveal truth

Strategic synthesis and pattern recognition across industries

Understanding of how strategy translates to user experience and website structure

Clear, strategic writing — every word earning its place

Facilitate clarity sessions with c suite executives and present the strategy plan

Communicate effectively in team environment



Nice to Have:



Experience using AI tools to accelerate research, validate findings, and optimize workflow



Required:



Native-level English proficiency (fluent written and spoken)

Availability to work on Arizona time (US Mountain Time)

Rent Collection Coordinator (Bilingual English/Spanish) 



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM Pacific Time with a 30-minute break

Salary: $1,500 per month



Job Overview: 

We are seeking an experienced and highly professional Rent Collection Coordinator (Bilingual English/Spanish) to manage tenant communications and rent collection activities for a residential property management portfolio. This role is responsible for proactively following up on rent payments, resolving tenant inquiries, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring timely collection of outstanding balances.

The ideal candidate has prior experience in rent collection or property management, is fluent in both English and Spanish, and is comfortable spending the majority of the workday on Zoom and phone calls communicating with tenants and internal teams.

* Contact tenants regarding rent payments, overdue balances, and payment arrangements

* Conduct outbound and inbound calls with tenants in both English and Spanish

* Follow up on delinquent accounts and document all communication activities

* Attend Zoo
etings throughout the day and remain available for tenant and team communications

Required Skills & Qualifications:

* Fluent in both English and Spanish (written and verbal)

* Experience working with residential property management companies

* Proven experience in rent collection, accounts receivable, collections, property management, or a related field

* Yardi knowledge / experience is a plus. 

* Strong knowledge of rent collection processes, payment plans, and delinquency management

* Experience handling high-volume phone calls and tenant communications

* Strong conflict resolution and negotiation skills

* Experience supporting US-based tenants or customers

* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

* Ability to document conversations and maintain accurate records

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace

* Strong time management skills and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment

* Professional, dependable, and customer service-oriented

title: Hiring: Experienced Real Estate Assistant
description:
REAL ESTATE LEAD GENERATION SPECIALIST



ROLE SUMMARY:

The Real Estate Lead Generation Specialist is responsible for identifying motivated property owners, building rapport, qualifying leads, and setting appointments for the acquisitions team. This role is focused on creating opportunities through strong communication, follow-up, and relationship-building skills while maintaining a results-driven mindset.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:



* Engage with property owners through SMS, phone calls, and follow-up conversations

* Build trust and maintain professional communication with sellers

* Qualify leads by gathering property details, motivation, timeline, and pricing expectations

* Identify motivated sellers and move them through the acquisition pipeline

* Set appointments for the acquisitions team

* Update CRM notes, lead tags, and follow-up schedules accurately

* Research property information, comparables, and market activity when needed

* Maintain consistent follow-up with warm and hot leads

* Handle objections professionally and confidently

* Work closely with the acquisitions team to prepare opportunities for offers



IDEAL TRAITS:

Primary Trait – Influence (I)



* Strong communication and relationship-building skills

* Friendly, engaging, and confident personality

* Able to create rapport quickly with sellers

* Persuasive without sounding aggressive

* Comfortable leading conversations naturally



Secondary Trait – Dominance (D)



* Goal-oriented and competitive

* Confident handling objections and negotiations

* Persistent and self-motivated

* Able to stay focused under pressure

* Takes initiative and drives conversations toward appointments



IDEAL CANDIDATE:



* Excellent English communication skills

* Comfortable speaking with strangers daily

# Wedding Photo Editor – Contract Position



## Overview



Vaughan Visuals is seeking a reliable wedding photo editor to assist with post-production on wedding galleries. This is a contract-based position with the opportunity for ongoing work as booking volume increases.



The ideal candidate has experience editing wedding photography, maintaining color consistency throughout a gallery, and delivering clean, natural-looking edits that match an established editing style.



## Workflow



* All photos will be culled prior to delivery.

* Our lead photographer will edit approximately 100–120 images from each wedding gallery for previews, social media content, and style reference.

* Lightroom presets will be provided.

* Multiple edited sample images from the wedding will be provided as color and style references.

* The editor will be responsible for matching the remaining gallery to the established look and feel.



## Responsibilities



* Apply provided Lightroom presets and make necessary adjustments.

* Match color grading and overall style to photographer-edited reference images.

* Adjust exposure, white balance, contrast, highlights, shadows, and color balance as needed.

* Correct horizons and minor composition alignment issues when necessary.

* Maintain consistency across the entire gallery.

* Export and return edited files according to provided specifications.

* Edit roughly
culled photos depending on the shoot



## Requirements



* Experience editing wedding photography.

* Proficiency in Adobe Lightroom

* Strong understanding of color correction and white balance.

* Ability to closely match an existing editing style.

* Attention to detail and consistency throughout large galleries.

* Ability to meet agreed-upon turnaround times.



## Editing Style



We prioritize:



* Clean, timeless edits

* Natural skin tones

* Consistent color throughout the gallery

* True-to-life whites and balanced exposures

* A polished, professional look without overly aggressive editing



## What We Provide



* Fully culled RAW files

* Lightroom presets

Leading and controlling the day-to-day property operations function

Controlling maintenance workflow from report to resolution

Ensuring records, trackers, folders, and systems stay accurate and updated

Managing staff performance, follow-up, and accountability

Escalating only genuine owner-level issues

Helping improve systems, checklists, and operational discipline

What success looks like





Property operations run in a controlled and predictable way

Tasks are not dropped

Tenant, landlord, guest, and contractor communication is timely and professional

The owner is not dragged into routine chasing

Records, spreadsheets, and systems are accurate and usable

Problems are solved, not just reported





Important



This role requires both:



- strong UK property management knowledge, and

- real people-management ability



If you are excellent at doing tasks yourself but struggle to manage others, follow up on staff, or hold standards, this role is probably not the right fit.



To apply

Your CV

A short cover message

how many years you have worked directly with UK lettings / property management

what exact tasks and responsibilities you handled yourself

how many years you have managed people

how many people you managed

what kind of team you managed

how you monitored performance

how you dealt with missed tasks, poor performance, and accountability

improving occupancy

reducing voids

improving response times

reducing missed tasks

setting up better systems

improving maintenance follow-up

improving team performance

reducing owner involvement in operations



Please be specific. General statements like “I am hardworking” or “I am a fast learner” are not enough.



Application process



1. To apply, please include this exact phrase in your application subject line:



UK Property Operations Lead – Reliable and Detail-Focused



Applications without this exact subject line will not be considered.



2. In your application or cover
, please answer this:

title: $10/hour: Short-Form Video Editor + Content Scheduler (TikTok/Reels)
description:
Hi, I'm Andrew. I run two e-commerce brands and a personal channel. Yesterday alone, one video I created hit 2M+ views on IG, and I'm looking for a coachable long-term video editor to keep the virality spree going. You'll be directly tasked with creating content for brands with a combined 30,000+ followers and an algorithm that's currently on fire. You will be making a real impact.



The deal:

- $10 USD/hour via Hubstaff, growing as the role grows

- Paid every 2 weeks via Wise, on time

- Pro-rated 13th month bonus every December

- Long-term role with growing hours and responsibilities

- Paid 2-week trial period before formal long-term hiring



The role starts at 10 hrs/week. It will grow toward full-time as we continue to scale and I trust you more and more.



I keep my people: I have another VA who's been with me for over a year. She started at 30 minutes a week and now works 20-30 hours a week with multiple raises along the way. When I say long-term and growing, I mean it.



Schedule: Flexible on when you work. What matters is the posting calendar: videos edited, scheduled, and live on time, every day.



~80% short-form content, ~10% long-form content, ~10% scheduling said content



To be clear: short-form IS this role. If you're elite at short-form and just decent at long-form, you're exactly who I'm looking for. If long-form explainers are your specialty, this isn't your job.



What you'll do:

- Edit short-form videos (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) for my brands: hooks, captions, pacing, sound

- Main work entails working with AI-generated video clips (Higgsfield) and making viral short-form content: assembling, polishing, and making them feel native to the platform

- Schedule and publish all content via Metricool across multiple accounts

- Follow and improve our content SOPs (hook formulas, caption styles, what's working)

- Secondary task: edit my personal channel. 5-10 minute talking-head videos plus shorts, 1-2 per week, simple clean style

- Communicate with me daily via WhatsApp (async, I don't expect instant replies)

- Take on new responsibilities as the business grows



Hard skills required (short-form specific):

- Elite short-form editing in CapCut: hooks that stop the scroll in under 1 second, pacing that holds retention, captions and sound that feel native to the platform

- You can look at a video's first 3 seconds and tell me why it will or won't get pushed by the algorithm

- A track record editing for TikTok/Reels/Shorts specifically. Show me, don't tell me.

- You watch short-form daily and know the difference between an amazing video, a good one, and a bad one

- Comfortable with Metricool (or willing to learn quickly)

- Good written English, reliable internet, and a machine that can handle editing



Soft skills required:



- Highly coachable: I'll teach you our brand styles, hook formulas, and workflows. Learn fast and ask good questions.

- Detail-oriented: a typo in a caption or a video posted to the wrong account costs real money

- Consistent: this role lives and dies on the posting schedule

- Has taste: you should have opinions about why a video is boring and how to fix it



How to apply: No skills test, no essay. Just message me the link to one Loom video, covering these things. 5 minutes max or you will be disqualified. Being concise is crucial in this role, refilm if needed:



- About yourself. Your short-form editing experience and why you fit this role

- One thing that actually makes you you (a weird hobby, a strong opinion, your worst cooking disaster, anything but "I'm passionate about editing")

- Screen-share 1-2 short-form videos you've edited that performed well (TikTok/Reels/Shorts, NOT long-form explainers, those will be ignored) and walk me through: why that hook, why that cut, what you'd change now. Show me the timeline. If you've run accounts with big view counts, drop those links too.

- Please attach your portfolio via Google Drive if you have it. If not OK. Loom is the most important part.



One real ask: don't run this through ChatGPT and read it off a script. I can tell instantly, it's painfully obvious, and it looks exactly like every other application. I'd genuinely rather watch you fumble through a real answer than nail a robotic one. Be a person, get creative, go off-script. There are no rules here, I just want it from the heart. I will watch every single Loom. Impress me, be different, and be creative!
